key.name: glass-effects
key.description: Use translucent glass surfaces. When off, every surface uses its solid fallback colour.

key.name: background-blur
key.description: Blur the desktop behind the top bar and the dock.

key.name: transparency
key.description: Let the wallpaper show through glass surfaces. When off, surfaces are almost opaque.

key.name: glass-borders
key.description: Draw the hairline edge around glass surfaces.

key.name: shadows
key.description: Draw drop shadows under panels, menus and dialogs.

key.name: rounded-corners
key.description: Use the theme's radius scale. When off, a small uniform radius is used.

key.name: glass-intensity
key.description: How translucent glass surfaces are. 100 is the designed value, 0 is opaque.

key.name: blur-intensity
key.description: Strength of the background blur. 100 is the designed value.

key.name: accent
key.description: Colour used for active and selected states. "system" follows the GNOME accent colour.

key.name: appearance
key.description: Follow the system style, or force the dark or light appearance.

key.name: dialogs-style
key.summary: Glass dialogs, overlays and lock screen

key.name: window-style
key.description: Write a GTK stylesheet that applies the theme's colours, radii and window controls to GTK applications.

key.name: terminal-style
key.description: Give the default Ptyxis profile the theme's palette and translucency. The profile's previous palette and opacity are restored when this is off.

key.name: icon-theme
key.description: Switch to the Ubuntu-Glass icon theme. The previous icon theme is restored when this is turned off.

key.name: wallpaper
key.description: Use one of the theme wallpapers. The previous wallpaper is restored when this is turned off.

key.name: high-contrast
key.description: Strengthen edges and secondary text, and make surfaces more opaque.

key.name: show-indicator
key.summary: Show the Glass tile in Quick Settings

key.name: preset
key.description: Set to "custom" as soon as a setting that a preset controls is changed by hand.

key.name: backup
key.description: JSON record of the system settings the extension changed, used to restore them. Not meant to be edited.
